d: Kylian Mbappe and Ousmane Dembele have won together, celebrated together and represented France on football's biggest stage. But the reported tension between them has brought an unexpected trouble into the France national team before the UEFA Nations League, with the Ballon d'Or race reportedly adding to the discomfort. Rupha Ramani examines how a rivalry between two former PSG teammates could affect France, why Mbappe's role as captain matters and whether Zinedine Zidane can manage the egos of two superstars ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026.
